sourceAuthority.founderRuling: Give CAS agents network access by default while retaining explicit networkAccess:false and leaving filesystem, approval, TLS, authentication, and secret boundaries unchanged.

authorizedWriteSurfaceAmendments.reason: The public delegate_agent MCP schema and adapter are the traced direct-handoff caller boundary and must not drop explicit false.
The existing real stdio protocol spec is the lowest faithful public-boundary proof for direct handoff propagation.

rows.expectedMeaningfulRed: An agent with omitted networkAccess freezes and forwards no effective permission instead of true.
rows.observableGreen: Omitted networkAccess resolves once to true, is present on the frozen node and execution request, and therefore appears in local and durable workflow journals.

rows.expectedMeaningfulRed: An explicit networkAccess:false is absent from the frozen node and can drift to the default.
rows.observableGreen: Explicit false is preserved identically in the frozen node and execution request and changes the frozen event bytes from the default-true case.

rows.expectedMeaningfulRed: A non-boolean networkAccess value reaches the execution adapter.
rows.observableGreen: Any defined non-boolean value fails as WORKFLOW_DEFINITION_INVALID before node freeze or adapter launch.

rows.expectedMeaningfulRed: The strict runtime profile rejects the optional field and turn/start has no network sandbox policy.
rows.observableGreen: Direct delegation freezes omitted as true, preserves explicit false, rejects non-booleans before lease/provider calls, fingerprints the effective permission, and sends it on initial and resumed turns.
rows.cleanup: Synthetic connections only; no external resources.

rows.expectedMeaningfulRed: Every workflow turn hard-codes networkAccess:false regardless of effective node permission.
rows.observableGreen: The effective network boolean is sent exactly while readOnly remains readOnly and workspaceWrite retains only its existing writable roots and temp exclusions; invalid values reject before thread creation.
rows.cleanup: Synthetic feed is closed and active turn count returns to zero.

rows.runtime: Vitest through in-process durable execution plus real stdio JSON-RPC and MCP protocol boundaries
rows.expectedMeaningfulRed: The real protocol witnesses receive false for omitted workflow nodes and the public direct-handoff schema cannot carry explicit false.
rows.observableGreen: Real protocol witnesses observe true for omitted workflow nodes, false for explicit opt-out, the public MCP boundary preserves false, and the durable daemon journals the same effective per-node values without changing model, reasoning, sandbox, approval, ordering, replay, or cleanup.
rows.cleanup: All child protocol processes and in-process durable executors/workspace leases close in finally-equivalent paths with zero delta.

rows.runtime: Pinned Codex App Server command/exec with no thread, turn, agent, or model
rows.target: manual bounded no-model App Server protocol probe
rows.expectedMeaningfulRed: The predecessor probe under networkAccess:false fails with DNSResolveFailed while the current workflow executor cannot request true.
rows.observableGreen: The same bounded network operation succeeds with effective default true and explicit false still fails at the network boundary; both probes use isolated writable roots and are cleaned in finally.
rows.cleanup: The owned App Server child and private probe roots are removed in finally; process and filesystem delta is zero.

freezeRule: After all seven rows show meaningful RED, freeze row identities, test titles, assertions, default true, explicit false, invalid-input rejection, filesystem/network separation, exact turn/start policy shape, protocol witnesses, cleanup, and the coordinator-stop boundary before product implementation.
acceptanceLimitation: This worker stops READY-FOR-REVIEW. The coordinator owns the paid three-stage Luna-low Bun reproof, fresh Preflight, independent verification, judgment, and promotion gates.
